reviews.text: I’m really impressed with the Hugrab V2 Pro! It’s so easy to use and the design is super user-friendly. I noticed an immediate reduction in puffiness after just one use, and my skin feels tighter and more lifted. The included gel works perfectly with the device, no irritation at all. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a home care device that actually delivers results!
reviews.zh: 我對 Hugrab V2 Pro 真係好欣賞！佢超級易用，設計都好人性化。我只係用咗一次，就即刻見到浮腫減少咗，皮膚感覺更加緊緻、更提拉咗。附送嘅啫喱同儀器配合得非常好，完全冇刺激。推薦畀所有想搵一部真係有效嘅家用儀器嘅人！

reviews.text: Fun little experience, I'm not sure about the benefits, skin did feel smoother and 'bouncy'(?), but like most masks, the effects are gone after a couple of hours, maybe with more consistent use (one or twice a week maybe) the effects would hold on longer. Will likely repurchase just for the fun of applying it (my roommate certainly appreciated me being quiet for once thanks to the mask lol)
reviews.zh: 好有趣嘅體驗，我唔太肯定有咩功效，皮膚感覺似係更滑、更『彈』(?)，但同大部分面膜一樣，效果幾個鐘之後就冇咗，可能如果更加持續使用（或者每星期一至兩次），效果會維持得耐啲。我好大機會會再買，純粹因為塗嘅過程好好玩（我室友好感激，因為多得呢個面膜，我難得安靜咗一次，哈哈）

reviews.text: I saw a lot of people buying the tea tree modeling pack, but I got this one to try with my boyfriend. Of course, you can’t expect visible results after just one use, but it does leave your skin feeling hydrated and nice. The only downside is that it’s a bit of a hassle to prepare 😅
reviews.zh: 我見好多人買茶樹軟膜，但我買咗呢款同男朋友一齊試。當然，用一次唔可能見到明顯效果，但皮膚確實有滋潤、舒服嘅感覺。唯一缺點係準備起嚟有啲麻煩 😅

reviews.text: Deeply cleans pores. Compact and lightweight packaging makes it convenient to carry when traveling. It is very moisturizing, brightening and easy to use.
reviews.zh: 深層清潔毛孔。包裝細小輕便，旅行時攜帶好方便。非常滋潤、提亮，而且好易用。

reviews.text: Well, here’s me giving one more chance to modeling masks. To be honest, it did… pretty much nothing for me. Didn’t see any particular effect once I removed it. Not to mention that the whole “peels off in one piece” thing did not work for me whatsoever. I had to pick off plenty of stubborn mask pieces by hand, and wash off the stubbornest ones with water. Meh is my verdict.
reviews.zh: 好啦，我又俾軟膜多一次機會。老實講，佢對我基本上冇乜作用。除走之後，都冇見到任何特別效果。更加唔使講所謂「一整塊撕走」，對我完全冇用。我要用手逐塊撕走好多頑固嘅面膜碎片，最頑固嗰啲仲要用水沖走。總括嚟講，一般而已。

reviews.text: Este formato de mascarilla en gel son mi nueva obsesión ya que tu piel queda muy sabe e hidratante vienen con una cuchara para poder agregar la cantidad de liquido y en la misma cuchara la parte del mango es como una paleta para poder revolver y aplicarla en tu rostro, esta marca no se seca tan rápido como otras, hace un poco mas de grumo así que recomiendo ir agregando agua de apoco hasta lograr la consistencia deseada, se demora en secar mas que otras mascarillas mas de 20 minutos
reviews.zh: 呢種啫喱面膜係我嘅新迷戀，皮膚會變得好 sabe（柔滑）同保濕。佢配有一支匙羹，可以加入適量嘅液體；匙羹柄嘅部分好似一個調色板，可以用嚟攪拌，然後塗喺面上。呢個品牌唔似其他品牌咁快乾，而且會有少少粒粒，所以建議逐少逐少加水，直至達到理想嘅稠度。乾透所需時間比其他面膜長，超過 20 分鐘。

reviews.text: Loved the feel of the mask. It was my first time using a modeling clay mask and I really liked it. It firmed up faster than I was expecting, so you have to apply it quickly, but my skin felt really nice after.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款面膜嘅質感。呢個係我第一次用軟膜，我好鍾意。佢凝固嘅速度比我預期快，所以要快手塗，但用完之後皮膚感覺好好。

reviews.text: Went on really good but dries out really quickly and looks like playdough. It's unusable after a few seconds (doesn't dry, doesn't apply smoothly etc)
reviews.zh: 塗上去幾好，但好快就乾，睇落似膠泥（playdough）。塗咗幾秒就用唔到（唔乾、塗得唔順滑等等）

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
